meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会作为写作搭档,和你一起列大纲、查资料并加引用、改进开头、对你写好的每一节给反馈,最后整体检查和润色,同时尽量保持你原有的文风。
howto.when: 当你说要写文章、列大纲,或请它对已写段落给反馈时,它就接管。

say.text: 帮我为《AI对产品管理的影响》列个大纲。
say.note: 它会先问清主题、读者和目标,再产出结构化大纲。

say.text: 我写好了引言,帮我看看开头够不够吸引人。
say.note: 它会分析现状并给出几种改法。

say.text: 我刚写完「常见错误」一节,给我点反馈。
say.note: 它会按清晰度、逻辑、证据等逐项给建议。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a writing partner: it helps outline, does research and adds citations, improves hooks, gives feedback on each section you write, and does a final polish while trying to preserve your voice.
howto.when_en: It kicks in when you say you want to write an article, create an outline, or ask for feedback on a section you've written.

say_en.text: Help me outline an article about AI's impact on product management.
say_en.note: It asks clarifying questions, then drafts an outline.

say_en.text: I've written my introduction. Can you make the hook more compelling?
say_en.note: It analyzes the hook and offers several alternatives.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Common Mistakes' section. Give me feedback.
say_en.note: It reviews clarity, flow, evidence, and style.
